stopRules: Exactly one matched REST/Kafka pair at the specified fixed rate and scenario; stop for review after two runs. No automatic rate search or repetition.
Stop immediately for invalid evidence, safety/correctness failure, controller/cleanup failure, changed provenance or competing containers.
Queue patterns, latency, recovery and backlog clearance are descriptive. Censored recovery is retained, not zero, and never a capacity or correctness failure by itself.
Review the prerequisite pair and bind its immutable evidence before preparing or launching this stage. Preserve all historical evidence.
Pause only at a complete matched pair; a completed pair cannot resume. No further stage may start after a user pause until explicitly requested.
Two hours per pair is a cumulative safety ceiling, not an ETA. No capacity verdict or confirmatory study is authorized.
